subject.title: feat(macos): native-feel dashboard hosting — instant reopen, preload, frame autosave, ⌘N/⌘K, route memory

question: After the two behavior blockers are fixed and signed-app proof is added, should the complete preload, persistent-state, and native-shortcut feature land as the intended macOS hybrid-shell direction?
rationale: The protected label and broad native-shell lifecycle changes require an explicit owner decision even after mechanical correctness and proof gates are satisfied.

options.title: Sponsor after fixes
options.body: Land the complete feature after shell acknowledgment, route-hash persistence, and redacted signed-app proof are present.

options.title: Narrow the first landing
options.body: Land only independently proven native-shell improvements and defer preload or route persistence to a follow-up.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Keep current dashboard hosting behavior until maintainers want to accept the additional persistent state and lifecycle complexity.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after fixes
recommendation.body: Land the complete feature after shell acknowledgment, route-hash persistence, and redacted signed-app proof are present.

likelyOwner.reason: The implementation follows the macOS hybrid-shell direction steipete has been driving across the native app and Control UI boundary.
